title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00385068874146 (+0.00002253269229 over #7767)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This construction gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.00385068874146** on a fully charged 48-call P104 multiplier. The directed raw crossing is **[0.00385068874154, 0.00385068874155]**.

| Comparison | Directed upper | Gain to the new finite lower |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Submitted base #7767 | 0.00382815604917 | **+0.00002253269229** |
| Ali Romman’s released 48-call supplier | 0.00384022183446 | **+0.00001046690700** |
| Original round comparator #7761 | 0.00382069832566 | **+0.00002999041580** |

Start with the literal #7767 word. Reverse seven incompatible bypasses and charge their surrendered savings. Carry two hub rebindings and eight 4+2→6 restorations into Ali’s 1,264-role supplier. A second reconstruction from his public word gives the same complete intermediate and schedule. Ten new source and terminal edits then change the complete 48-call invoice from 283,776 to **282,912 paid positions** while preserving all **51,312 productive targets**. Two retired identifiers acquire distinct, fully charged later lifetimes. The candidate’s canonical native SHA-256 is `c048d660a0e77925a91597c3a554c736bab11d870c1753c2c35e5657a4974f48`.

## Task and overlap

The assigned κ goal continues #7761 at its original target 0.00383069832566. Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` still selects #7000 at 0.00363005817. The strongest formal PR in the pre-submission review was #7767 at `1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94`. The comparison also uses Ali Romman’s stronger 48-call release at `6b0b2f7de0f068834264fc50b75a39a72c52ea22`. His 02:50 UTC update reports a further provisional crossing on a 1,024-call price and ongoing work on a complete caller. This submission gives the independently reproducible gain against his released 48-call word under the common BIT of 0.00385248. [Prior submission](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7767) · [Public supplier and parallel update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19721588) · [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19724028)

## Validation

The enclosed receipts cover all 1,264 native inputs in both directions, all 104 main ports, 840,912 caller instructions, signed chart phases, guarded CLEAR, literal integer division, ordinary services and 54 strict plus four functional compiler checks. Dropping each of the ten extra paid repairs changes a named public output. The candidate needs half the donor’s exact product grid. The complete application charges the original odd conversion factors and the increased scalar-service bill.

From `research/p104-closed-supplier-relays`, run the following with Python 3.12 and its standard library. The cache contains SHA-256 and Git-blob-verified immutable public source files. The default command also runs offline after the cache is populated.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B prepare_sources.py /tmp/p104-source-cache --fetch
python3.12 -I -B verify.py --cache /tmp/p104-source-cache --output /tmp/p104-result
```

## Credit

DreamingOfClouds supplied the chart-hub and banked-circuit work with Claude assistance, plus the signed-curvature gate. The construction also inherits work by SYLforge, Rohan Arun, Douglas Colkitt, Jerry Chen (CubeJerry) and the contributors listed in the package notices. [Earlier P104 graph](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7756) · [Hub reroutes](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7705) · [Banked toolkit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7727)

## Open next questions

I’m requesting maintainer frontier review of this compatible finite gain under the five inherited assumptions of native all-column realization, owned erasure, compiler, precision tape and analytic recovery. A small first review is the 99771/104247 substitution and its omitted-leg witness, followed by the full directed price. Selection and admission are for the maintainers.
